behaviorGuarantees: Level and OK/NG are the two visible map modes; NG red independent of deviation magnitude; reset state gray and distinct from a real measured zero
actual received measurements advance a monotonic UI receipt and reveal the last point at right; move-only/import/refresh never fabricate measurements
current-position one-point measurement does not move; existing arrival/interlock/current-frame validation retained
only movement-bearing actions request confirmation; nonmoving operations react immediately; normal file choosers retained
map remains primary; filters/legend/work info at right; compact result/scatter, graph before collapsed axis settings
whole model/Cell/Head reset is a staged draft; same Cell/Shot Beam siblings share one offset; unrelated values retained
Hardware/Default/First Beam/Distortion and Config/Data/theme/device sequences unchanged; shared writer adds optional state metadata only
CSV stores INITIALIZED/MEASURED and per-row reset timestamp; previous files remain; real zero never inferred initialized from its number
new raw after a reset is measurable; pre-reset raw stays provenance; unrelated saves retain the original row reset boundary
normal apply clears initialized state for every sibling of the changed Shot; revision/rollback restores values and state with a renewed reset boundary
absolute portable schema2 retains reset metadata, reads schema1, and never applies exported protected settings or scanner commands
current working revision is restored, not an arbitrary historic CSV including out-of-model legacy rows; historical files remain
scatter defaults to WORKING measurement deviation, with original/cumulative B supplementary views; B history is not current residual precision
Simple/Rough/Fine/One/All/Line use the latest cumulative map only; same raw is never added again
no read-only user mode; editable current-frame reconnection and exact Recovery archive guards retained
notExecuted: physical OS double-click/key injection or monitor DPI switch
